category: document parsing API, one-time free credit

free_tier.stated: USD 150 of free usage on the Standard plan, then list rates apply: Parse (r-1) USD 10 per 1,000 pages, Extract USD 20 per 1,000 pages
free_tier.notes: the credit is denominated in USD; at the USD 10 per 1,000 pages r-1 Parse list rate, USD 150 / USD 10 per 1,000 pages = 15,000 pages. A third-party list prints '15k free credits' for the same free tier. Whether the USD 150 renews is unverified: the pricing page says 'your free $150' and names no period

per_object_cap.stated: 100 MB per file through direct upload; 5 GB through a presigned-URL upload

retention.stated: uploaded files expire 24 hours after upload

interface_detail: REST (POST https://platform.reducto.ai/parse with a Bearer API key), SDKs, a CLI (reducto-cli) and an MCP server
tooling: the Reducto Python, Node.js and Go SDKs, the reducto-cli command line, the MCP server, or plain REST with an API key created in Reducto Studio
chaining: a one-time USD 150 credit worth about 15,000 r-1 Parse pages, with the Standard plan's 'No Page Limits' meaning pay-as-you-go afterwards; useful for a single bulk job rather than a recurring free lane

limits.value: USD 150 of free usage on the Standard plan; r-1 Parse is USD 10 per 1,000 pages at list rates effective 2026-09-01; unverified whether the credit renews
100 MB per file by direct upload, 5 GB by presigned URL; 30+ file types including PDFs, images, spreadsheets, presentations and scanned documents
1,000 requests per second sustained per API key on all endpoints at the API edge, returning HTTP 429 above it; parallel parse work is separately queued by a concurrency throttle

identity_cost.detail: a free account created at studio.reducto.ai ('sign up for a free account'), then an API key from Studio; unverified: the sign-up form's fields and whether a card is asked, since studio.reducto.ai answers a login wall to every reader route tried

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; the list prices changed on 2026-09-01 and legacy credit rates were retired, and no request was made because a key needs a signed-in account
confidence_note: the USD 150 free usage, the page prices, the upload caps and the edge rate limit are quoted from vendor pages read on 2026-11-03; the sign-up fields, any card requirement and the renewal of the credit are unverified, and no request was made.
